pages.title: Plates & Rods
pages.text: The $(bold)Stonecutter$() lets you turn ingots into flat $(bold)Plates$() and thin $(bold)Rods$(). These are needed for machine recipes. Copper and iron both follow the same pattern: ingot → plate → rod.
Iron Rod directly from an ingot, or from a plate.
Copper Plate — needed for Copper Coils and machine parts.
Copper Coil — made from Copper Rods. Used in electronics.

pages.title: Steel
pages.text: $(bold)Steel$() is the strongest crafted metal. Smelt Iron Ingots in a $(bold)Blast Furnace$() to get Steel Ingots. Then use the Stonecutter to make Steel Plates and Rods. Steel is used to upgrade tools and build advanced machines.
Blast Furnace required — much faster than a regular furnace.
